title: bloquesitos
description: Cute & vanilla block variants, pastel colors, and pretty armor designs!
body:
🌺 About the Mod
Welcome to a cozier Minecraft experience! This mod is heavily inspired by cozy cottagecore aesthetics and the beautiful art style of Mizuno’s. It adds a soft, whimsical touch to your world with pastel palettes and adorable new designs.

🌸 Features:
Cute Pastel Blocks: Give your builds a soft makeover! Enjoy new pastel color variants for Amethyst, Quartz, Emerald, Terracotta, Copper, and Cobblestone—beautifully decorated with delicate cherry petals.

Strawberry Armor: A sweet, cute, and functional armor set to match your aesthetic.

Beyond Netherite (New Ores): Discover two brand-new tiers of endgame materials that surpass Netherite:

🌼Isidonita: A stunning, powerful pink ore, with pink heart ingots

🍃Edunita: A magical, glowing light-blue ore.

🌵New Toolsets: Two complete sets of tools and weapons crafted from both Isidonite and Edunite.

🍓New plant: Grow strawberries to create cute blocks and tools.

🗡2 New Bosses: Defeat bosses to create powerful tools above netherite!

🎀 Coming Soon: More colors and pastel variants are already on the way!
